remarks: FURNISHED Yearly Rental in Sought-After Hycliff Association - Comfort, Community & Convenience. Welcome to this charming, fully furnished four-bedroom Colonial located in the highly desirable Westover private association. Thoughtfully updated, the home features a renovated kitchen and baths, a dedicated home office, and a private yard with a patio-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Enjoy an active and welcoming neighborhood with access to a association pool, playground, seasonal block parties, and book clubs. Whether you're looking to connect or simply enjoy the amenities, Hycliff offers a lifestyle that suits many. Ideally positioned for flexibility and convenience, you're just a short walk to the vibrant downtown Stamford scene or the coastal charm of Old Greenwich, with its shops, restaurants, and beach-town feel. With an easy commute to NYC, you can enjoy the best of both city and coastal living. This move-in-ready home offers comfort, style, and community-all in one great location.
